# The offset an engine validation message names, one case per line: `<want>|<message>`.
# -1 means the message names none. Read by tests/vl_engine_fail_offset_test.ts (the VL
# `engineFailOffset`, compiler/engine_msg.vl) and by the host's `engine_offset_tests`
# (`engine_fail_offset`, scripts/vl-host/src/main.rs; `cargo test engine_offset`).
# A message holds no `|`, `"` or backslash, so both readers take it verbatim.
